name: Hana ni Utau Shoujo
source:
Sarah, a human girl who can converse with flowers, is transported to the fairy world on the day of her wedding. Lost and despairing in this unfamiliar realm, she is warmly welcomed by a diverse group of fairies.
Then, as if she'd been guided to him, she encounters a mysterious black-haired fairy boy named Ed. To return to the human world, Sarah journeys with Ed to find the "Fragments of the Song".

The millennia-old war between the human and fairy worlds, the resemblance to the "princess" that the fairies saw in Sarah, Ed's true identity, the mysterious voice heard by Sarah's fiancé Michel, the ultimate destination of faith, and the true purpose of the Fairy Queen, Selena...

When all prayers converge, a painfully tender and heartbreaking truth will be revealed.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13169]Novelgame[/url]]
